verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at the 6–6.5 anchor because its spacious, clearly sectioned layout remains readable with effort, but very small text and several long cross-board detours prevent comfortable arm's-length reading.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Nodes and label chips generally have generous clear space, though the board-wide scale makes many labels and captions visually small at arm's length.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Ten titled, lightly tinted regions make membership immediately clear, and each region maintains a coherent left-to-right procedural or component-map reading.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local arrows are clean and mostly labeled, but the long purple, red, orange, gray, and teal cross-region routes create perimeter-like detours that require substantial eye tracking and occasional backtracking.

sub_checks.name: density_and_decomposition
sub_checks.note: Air strongly dominates the board and most sections contain only two to four nodes, with no visibly crowded region or node collision.
